candidates.title: Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet selection so users choose their desktop pet before committing to creating or signing into an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% and adoption conversion is 60.9%; letting users select their companion pet first builds emotional investment before requesting account authentication.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet selection is explicitly allowed under Rule 4 and retains all steps.

candidates.score_note: Funnel shows sign-in and adoption drop-offs, but no direct support email evidence for reordering.

candidates.title: Redesign Waiting Screen with Progress Stage
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout featuring live progress tracking, generation status details, and estimated time remaining.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has a 201s median and 2336s mean duration, causing user drop-off while waiting for pet creation without clear feedback.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Arriving!
waiting.body: We are preparing your companion desktop pet.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen with progress tracking and estimated time retains its core function under Rule 2 and 5.

candidates.score_note: High wait time in funnel points to problem, but full redesign requires new screens.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Diagnostic Flow
candidates.change: Add a display verification checklist step on the finish screen to check rendering permissions and confirm desktop pet visibility.
candidates.why: Support received 3 reports of pets failing to show up on desktop or app not opening, and the finish step conversion is low at 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Let's make sure your desktop pet appears correctly on your screen.

guard.reason: Adding a display checklist to home_intro is an allowed onboarding extension under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel and support emails highlight this, but new screen additions historically showed negligible lift.

candidates.title: Split Card Path Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen into a split card layout highlighting adoption options with clear choice cards.
candidates.why: Choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a high mean time of 514s, indicating hesitation when picking an onboarding path.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Select whether you want to pick a standard pet or generate a custom friend.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Pet Generation Time Estimate & Notification Alert
candidates.change: Show an estimated wait time and allow users to toggle background notifications when pet generation completes.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a very long mean duration (2336s), causing users to close or abandon the app assuming it is stuck.

waiting.headline: Building Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: This usually takes about 2-3 minutes. You can minimize this window safely.

guard.reason: Estimated wait time and notification toggles on the waiting screen are allowed under Rules 2 and 5.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time duration in funnel, though support mail is silent on it.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Quick Hint
candidates.change: Display a persistent hint carousel on the home intro screen detailing mouse shortcuts to control, move, or hide the pet.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets from users confused about how to interact with, move, or minimize their pet after setup.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click your pet anytime to access controls, move them, or send them to sleep.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Quality Guidance
candidates.change: Add clear photo requirement copy and tips to the upload screen to guide users on high-quality pet photo selection.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion is low (60.9%).

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Use well-lit, front-facing photos with clear background contrast for best 3D pet generation results.
upload_photos.hint: Avoid blurry images or photos with multiple animals.

guard.reason: Adding photo quality guidance to the upload screen is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel and 3 support emails point to upload issues; low-cost copy change.

candidates.title: Account Sync & Cloud Save Assurance
candidates.change: Show a notification banner on sign-in clarifying that account login backs up pet data and enables recovery across re-installs.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.body: Your account keeps your custom pets safe across re-installs and updates.
sign_in.hint: Always use the same login method to restore your active pets.

guard.reason: Adding account backup assurance text to sign-in is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses top support complaint (8 emails) and sign-in drop-off with simple reassurance banner.
